learnings.rule: Color-encode country of origin with the ColorBrewer qualitative `Accent` palette via `scale_color_brewer(palette = "Accent")`.
Format the price (msrp) axis as plain comma-separated numbers with no dollar sign, e.g. `scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)`.
Place the legend at the bottom with `theme(legend.position = "bottom")`.
Make the scatter points larger, `size = 4.5` in geom_point.
Make the scatter points translucent, `alpha = 0.6` in geom_point.
